summary: the reviewer and qa agents write a result file for the exact commit, and the git pre-push hook and the merge gate refuse a code change without a passing review and QA result
appCreator: A code change can no longer be pushed or merged until the reviewer and qa agents have written a passing result for the final commit. Any later commit needs a new review and QA run. Docs-only changes are not affected.
notVerified: A real reviewer or qa agent writing its result through the script was not tried; the unit tests call the script directly. The merge gate was tested with a fake transcript, not a live PR.
